set(VULKAN_HEADERS_ENABLE_MODULE OFF)
add_subdirectory(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/vulkan-headers SYSTEM EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

set(VOLK_PULL_IN_VULKAN ON)
get_target_property(VULKAN_HEADERS_INSTALL_DIR Vulkan::Headers INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)
add_subdirectory(${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/volk SYSTEM EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
